contexts.text: The Horites in mount Seir () = false persuasions which are from the love of self. AC 1675. AC 1675:6, Explained.
Why the Horites were expelled from mount Seir.
Mount Seir, and Paran = the things of His Human essence, namely, the celestial things of love. Illustrated.
Seir is said as to celestial love; mount Paran, as to spiritual love.
The Lord's Divine Human is signified by mount Seir.
Edom, and Seir, the inheritance () = the Divine good of the Lord's Divine Natural.

Mount Seir, where Esau dwelt, has a similar signification, namely, what is shaggy; and, on this account, there was a mountain by which there was an ascent to Seir, which was called the smooth mountain () which was representative of truth ascending to good.

The land of Seir () = celestial natural good. The land of Seir, in the supreme sense, = the celestial natural good of the Lord; because mount Seir was the boundary of the land of Canaan on one side (), and all boundaries... represented ultimate things. AC 4240:2, Illustrated.
The land of Seir, in the relative sense, properly = the Lord's Kingdom with those outside the Church.

Until I come unto my lord in Seir ()... Seir = the conjunction of spiritual with celestial things in the Natural; that is, of the truth of faith with the good of charity. The good to which truth is conjoined in the Natural; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord's Divine Natural as to good conjoined with truth there, is what is properly signified by Seir in the following passages. Illustrated.
Esau returned on his way to Seir () = the state of Divine natural good to which were adjoined the truths of good... Seir = the conjunction of truth with good.
Esau dwelt in mount Seir () = the truth of natural good.
In mount Seir () = the truths of good.
Seir, out of which the watchman calls () = the illumination of the gentiles who are in darkness.
To go out of Seir... (), when said of Jehovah, = the illumination of the gentiles by the Lord when He assumed the Human.
